name: DCM Nouvelle Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, DCM Nouvelle Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and sale of cotton yarn[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
DCMNL is a part of the DCM Group. It is a BCI, GOTS and OEKO - TEX certified manufacturer & exporter of 100% cotton carded and combed yarns in single and two-ply forms in count range Ne 14s to 40s

pros: Stock is trading at 0.79 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.86% over last 3 years.
